name: contact_aware_benchmark
description: A benchmark focused on contact-aware perception and prediction for manipulation/interaction tasks. It contains annotations and sensor streams (e.g., tactile/force, kinematics, possibly vision) to evaluate models' ability to detect contact events, estimate contact forces/locations, and predict contact-driven outcomes. Designed for robotics and control research where awareness of object contact is critical to safe and effective manipulation.
general_score_metric: F1 (for contact detection) and MAE (for force/trajectory regression)
reputation: A specialized benchmark with limited but growing adoption in the robotics and tactile-sensing research community.
